svg.title: Vault, agent session and project repository
svg.desc: The vault holds knowledge, rules and state. An agent session reads from the vault and from a project repository, works with the agent proposing and the operator deciding, and curates: accepted knowledge goes to its one place, outdated statements are corrected or removed. A project repository holds its own knowledge, rules, code and data. The Repo Directory links each project to its knowledge folder.
svg.text: keep what holds, remove the outdated
Repo Directory links each project to its knowledge/
